description: XRouter (Astronaut Survival Manual) helps crews know the path before they walk it, on Mars and the Moon. On a 3D globe with NASA imagery and relief, the team traces a route by clicking and sees distance and travel time per vehicle, with warnings for vehicle range and time outside the base. The crew flags caution zones (soft soil, steep slopes) that slow the route and logs incidents for future missions. The tool does not detect hazards on its own.
